title: Plate Filling Master Mix in AB 384 Well Plate
author: Opentrons
materials: This protocol fills [Applied Biosystems MicroAmp 384-well plates]([https://www.thermofisher.com/order/catalog/product/4343370#/4343370) with mastermix. **Update**: this protocol can now accomodate the SSI 384-well plate as well. The protocol can fill up to 9 plates and will dispense 7.5µL of mastermix 1 into all the odd rows (A/C/E...) and 7.5µL of mastermix 2 into all the even rows (B/D/F...). This protocol has been updated to use the GEN2 Multi-Channel Pipettes - please use corresponding tips. **Update 09-21-20:** The protocol will now do a blow out in the well and aspirate 2µL of air at the top of the well after each dispense step to ensure all liquid has been expelled from pipette and minimize contamination risk due to droplet hang. **Update 09-25-20:** The protocol has been updated in two ways. First, the mastermix should be split between two wells (A1/A2 and A11/A12). Second, after aspirating the mastermix, the pipette will move to the sides of the well to remove liquid attached to the tips. **Update 10-29-20:** The protocol will now transfer 10µL of mastermix. **Update 10-30-20:** The protocol will now multi-dispense mastermix instead of 1-to-1 transfer. **Update 11-12-20:** The protocol now has a new parameter for master mix volume (default is 7.5µL) --- To purchase tips, reagents, or pipettes, please visit our [online store](https://shop.opentrons.com/) or contact our sales team at [info@opentrons.com](mailto:info@opentrons.com) * [Opentrons OT-2](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/ot-2-robot/products/ot-2) * [Opentrons OT-2 Run App (Version 3.19.0 or later)](https://opentrons.com/ot-app/) * [Opentrons Multi-Channel Pipette](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/ot-2-pipettes) * [Opentrons Tips](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/opentrons-tips/products/opentrons-10ul-tips) * [NEST 12-Well Reservoir](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/verified-labware/products/nest-12
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Download protocol file
steps.instruction: Download the OT‑2 protocol file for filling 384‑well plates from the provided link.

steps.title: Upload to OT App
steps.instruction: Open the Opentrons OT‑2 Run App (v3.19.0 or later) and upload the downloaded protocol file.

steps.title: Set up deck layout
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the protocol’s deck map: place up to nine Applied Biosystems MicroAmp 384‑well plates (or SSI 384‑well plates) in the designated plate slots, a NEST 12‑well reservoir containing the two master mixes, and a tip rack of Opentrons 10 µL tips for the GEN2 multi‑channel pipette.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT‑2 App, calibrate the positions of all labware and the GEN2 multi‑channel pipette (with the appropriate tips) following the standard calibration workflow.

steps.title: Run master mix dispensing
steps.instruction: Execute the protocol; the robot will dispense master mix as follows:

substeps.instruction: Aspirate master mix from two source wells (A1 & A2 for mix 1, A11 & A12 for mix 2) in the reservoir.
After each aspiration, move the tip to the side of the source well to remove liquid that adheres to the tip.

Using multi‑dispense mode, dispense the specified master‑mix volume (default 7.5 µL, updated to 10 µL) into target wells: master mix 1 into all odd rows (A, C, E, …) and master mix 2 into all even rows (B, D, F, …).
After each dispense, perform a blow‑out in the well and then aspirate 2 µL of air at the top of the well to ensure complete liquid expulsion and minimize droplet‑hang contamination.
The protocol can fill up to nine 384‑well plates in a single run.

steps.title: Start run
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT‑2 App to start the automated dispensing sequence.
